name: work
description: Implementation. Takes one task card, codes it, keeps the progress log on disk, runs the completion signal, and commits. Use when explicitly invoked, when another devflow skill routes here, or for work in an existing devflow-managed project.
problem: Preserve the behavior and evidence boundaries of repository-relative skills/work without silently changing its obligations or duplicating the principles state kernel.
use_cases: Claim or resume one approved card and carry its implementation through current completion evidence and clean review.
Recover anchored failure, objection, remote-evidence, integration, handoff, and finish-boundary transitions after interruption.
Promote one durable research synthesis to each named long-lived owner through an exact canonical knowledge marker.
Open closed history only from one exact current basis and close only after every observed passenger and source marker clears.
near_misses: A passing tweak; principles completes it and never invokes work.
Planning or repairing the card contract; direct owns it.
Writing current promoted knowledge; Arch owns it for every managed project.
Capability or product verification; verify owns it.
